radiusSource: Radius 1.17 ± 0.08 Earth radii from Torres et al. 2015 (ApJ 800, 99 (2015); arXiv:1501.01101), at 6378.137 km per Earth radius. No mass is measured, so no gravitational parameter is adopted. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius in the shared neutral gray. No image, colour, map or oblateness of Kepler-186 f is measured; only its size and orbit are.
